data.narrative:
Fuse Energy is a Series A nuclear energy company founded by JC Btaiche that has raised $78M to date and carries a last post-money valuation of $200M. The nuclear energy sector comp universe includes 3 public companies (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private firms, with notable private peers including Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

Stage-progression methodology is the only applicable triangulation approach here. Given the $200M last post-money valuation and applying a 2.0x multiplier typical for Series A to next-stage advancement, this method implies a forward valuation of $400M. A peer-median approach is not viable; while 5 nuclear energy companies exist in the broader dataset, only 0 same-stage comparables and 2 adjacent-stage peers meet narrow filtering criteria—below the 3-datapoint threshold necessary for statistical reliability.

The triangulation yields a median valuation of $400M with a range of $340M (low) to $460M (high), centered on the stage-progression result. Key uncertainties include the scarcity of same-stage nuclear energy comparables, limiting cross-validation of the 2.0x step-up assumption specific to this subsector. Validation of this range would benefit from additional market data on Series B pricing in frontier nuclear technologies and closer examination of how capital intensity and regulatory timelines affect valuation step-ups relative to software or biotech benchmarks.
